senses.gloss: m. (= גֵּוו הַרְקָא; cmp. Syr. חרוק acerbus P. Sm. 1384, a. h. חַרְצָן) sour and hard berry.—Pl. גּוּהַרְקֵי.
units: <cite ref="Pesachim 25b:5">Pes. 25ᵇ</cite> <he>גוהרקי</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>גוהרקיה</he>, Ar. <cite ref="C01391"><he>גרקי</he></cite>) undeveloped olives (used for rubbing the skin in fever).
